highlights.title: Models are ready in new worktrees
highlights.description: Your BotHub models load before a session starts, so a session moved to a new worktree no longer fails its first prompt with "Model unavailable" while the list loads.

highlights.title: Only BotHub to connect
highlights.description: /connect and bothub-code auth login offer BotHub and your MCP servers instead of every provider in the catalog, and the getting-started card stays until BotHub is connected.

highlights.title: Token counts read like CAPS
highlights.description: The sidebar groups the digits of token counts the same way as CAPS, whatever your system language.

highlights.title: Installing on Alpine
highlights.description: The curl installer asks for apk add libstdc++ libgcc on Alpine instead of installing a binary that cannot start there.

highlights.title: What's new after an update
highlights.description: After it updates, the app shows what changed in the new version.

highlights.title: Spending in CAPS
highlights.description: The terminal shows what a session spent in CAPS, as BotHub bills it, instead of dollars.

highlights.title: Long sessions stay fast
highlights.description: Conversations are compacted on Claude Haiku once they fill a fifth of the model's context window, keeping the newest 20,000 tokens as they are.

highlights.title: BotHub Code
highlights.description: The AI coding agent on BotHub models, in your terminal and as a desktop app.
